purpose: Findings the plan gate has already raised across six rounds, with how each was settled. A gate run discards any finding matching an entry here unless it can show the settled resolution is absent from the files.

settled.was: model required at spawn sites that could not supply one (CLI, MCP tool, job actions, mobile, schedules editors)
settled.resolution: model is optional everywhere; a chat takes its host's last-used model

settled.was: a brand-new host had no last-used model, so its first chat could not start
settled.resolution: seeded from the first catalogue the host reads successfully; absent until then, and a model-less spawn there is a loud error

settled.was: 04 said sending to an offline host fails, 12 and 15 said it queues
settled.resolution: a message into an existing chat and an editor save queue; a spawn is refused up front

settled.was: three auth rules on one daemon socket after unification
settled.resolution: one rule: the local key as Bearer from every caller including the MCP child

settled.was: daemon.host lacked lastUsedModel, override count, home-host marker, last-seen
settled.resolution: first three on daemon.host; auth.ok hosts[] shape stated with lastSeenAt

settled.was: patch_spawn required a daemonId no agent tool could supply
settled.resolution: patch_list_hosts, answered from GET /api/hosts with the daemonKey

settled.was: 02-daemon had the installer minting the pairing code, contradicting 10-auth
settled.resolution: a linked surface mints the nonce; the installer asks for the code and submits it

settled.was: the per-chat permission override had no surface control
settled.resolution: E2 owns the Tools-panel picker, including clear-to-host-default

settled.was: D3 routed speaker announcements to the home host
settled.resolution: they go to the machine the devices are paired with

settled.was: COVERAGE.md was all code references inside spec/
settled.resolution: moved to docs/, with desktop packaging notes

settled.was: B1 lacked A2, F1 lacked C5, G1 lacked C3
E3 cited a 05-surfaces heading renamed when the packaging notes moved
settled.resolution: anchor corrected; all plan spec_sections verified to resolve

settled.was: hello gained clientGitSha/clientBuiltAt but A1 did not name them
settled.resolution: A1 names them; both optional on the frame

settled.was: job examples outside the Action block omitted a field the Action block required
settled.resolution: every job spawn/ensure example checked and made consistent

settled.was: the one-line install command surfaces render had no server source
settled.resolution: B2 owns it as a retrievable contract; E1/F1 depend on B2 and do not compose it locally

accepted.decision: out of scope; the artifact is signed with the project identity only
no migration code; cutover is a clean re-pair (deploy.md)
D3 defines the rule once and the surfaces consume it; the spec deliberately does not pre-decide it
callkeep and Detox-vs-Maestro TBDs are not multi-host concerns and are out of scope for this change
I1 owns bringing the deploy recipe into line; deploy.md is not a spec file
the two-real-daemon rig lands in C1, once a daemon knows its host identity
physical voice-device clauses stay hardware- and human-gated
04 Spawn step 2's query() literal is illustrative; it need not enumerate every option the surrounding prose requires
a group that renders the host-grouped folder picker before the group that builds it may stub or share it; the orchestrator smooths this
